# 1977: The Ballot

<!-- STEP id="result" -->
## The Government Was Defeated

The ruling government was defeated. The general elections allowed people to express their will through the ballot.

This defeat demonstrated the strength of Indian democracy.

<!-- STEP id="what-it-showed" -->
## What the Period Showed

The period highlighted the importance of constitutional safeguards, civil liberties and active citizen participation.

**It showed both the vulnerabilities and the resilience of democratic institutions in India.**
